# Default configuration shared by all containers

# Setup the LXC devices in /dev/lxc/
lxc.tty.dir = lxc

# Allow for 1024 pseudo terminals
lxc.pty.max = 1024

# Setup 4 tty devices
lxc.tty.max = 4

# Setup the default mounts
lxc.mount.auto = cgroup:mixed proc:mixed sys:mixed

# create default devices
lxc.autodev = 1

# Blacklist some syscalls which are not safe in privileged
# containers
lxc.seccomp.profile = /etc/amx/cthulhu-lxc/common.seccomp

2

init_module errno 1

################################################################# 
# Index of the rule RULE = <GROUP>_<DESCRIPTION>[$] 
RULE = service_lcm-adapter


# Condition to start rule, existence of one of the following 
# START_COND = {NONE | FILE,[filename] | RULE_COMPLETED,[rule],..
#  | NET_DEVICE,[netdev] | IPC_OWNER,[owner] | ENV_VAR,[variable,value]}
START_COND = RULE_COMPLETED,service_cfgmgr,service_cthulhu

# Command with parameters
# COMMAND = <Full path>   [parameters] [$variable] 
COMMAND = /usr/bin/lcm-adapter

# Scheduling (priority) of the process 
# SCHED = {NICE,-19..19 | FIFO,1..99} 
SCHED = NICE 0

# Daemon flag - Process must not end 
# DAEMON = {YES | NO} 
DAEMON = YES

# Condition to end rule and move to next rule, wait for: 
# END_COND = {NONE | FILE,[filename] | NET_DEVICE,[netdevice]
#  | WAIT,[delay] | EXIT,[status] |   IPC_OWNER,[owner]} 
END_COND = NONE

# Timeout for end condition. Fail if timeout expires 
# END_COND_TIMEOUT = {-1 | 0..99999} 
END_COND_TIMEOUT = -1

# Action upon failure, do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
FAILURE_ACTION = RESTART

# Active rule, start automatically or manually 
# ACTIVE = {YES | NO} 
ACTIVE = YES

# User id for the process
# USER = { UID | User name }
################################################################

usr/bin/run_rlyeh.sh.text:
#!/bin/sh

UBUS_SOCKET="/var/run/ubus-session/ubus.sock"
OBJECTS="com.nokia.api.system hlapi.event.notify usp.raw"
MISSING=""

if [ ! -S "$UBUS_SOCKET" ]; then
    exit 1
fi

for OBJECT in $OBJECTS; do
    ubus -s /var/run/ubus-session/ubus.sock list | grep -qw "$OBJECT" || MISSING="$MISSING $OBJECT"
done

if [ -z "$MISSING" ]; then
    /usr/bin/rlyeh -D
    exit 0
fi
exit 1

FAILURE_ACTION = RESTART
